title: fix(cli): os doctor --verbose no longer ends by telling you to run with --verbose
body:
Fixes #34866

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：`os doctor` 以警告结束时，只有在没加 `--verbose` 的情况下才提示“Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions.”；加了 `--verbose` 的运行不再叫用户再加一次这个参数。
2. 为什么改：开发者第一次接触 CLI 时，`os doctor --verbose` 的结尾让人去传一个已经传过的参数，提示本身是错的。
3. 风险与回滚：只改了总结行的一个打印分支，不改退出码，也不改任何检查结果；撤回本 PR 即恢复原样。
4. 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`（总结里 `hasWarnings` 分支的 `if (!flags.verbose)`）；`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts`（新增的 `the warnings summary` 两个用例）。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts`，预期 14 passed。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`: in the summary's `hasWarnings` branch, the line "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions." is printed only when `flags.verbose` is false. Under `--verbose` every fix that doctor's warning paths have is already printed above the summary (`renderHealthCheckResult` prints `fix` when verbose, the dashboard-widget `hint` and the deprecation-scan `replacement` are verbose-gated), so the line pointed at nothing new.
- Non-verbose output is byte-for-byte unchanged. Exit codes are unchanged.
- `.changeset/34866-doctor-verbose-hint.md`: patch, `@objectstack/cli`.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts`: a new `describe('the warnings summary')` inside the existing real-`Doctor.run()` harness (same warning-bearing tree as the deprecation-scan cases). Both arms first assert the run reached the warnings branch of the summary, then judge the text after that verdict line by the flag it names: without `--verbose` it names `--verbose`; with `--verbose` it does not, and the per-finding replacement is on screen.

## Acceptance notes

- The mechanism assumption "under --verbose the fix suggestions are already printed" holds for every warning path that HAS a fix. Several warning paths have no fix in either mode: missing `*.test.ts` beside a `*.zod.ts`, `@deprecated` usages, circular dependencies, unused objects and orphan views print a bare `printWarning`. When only those warn, the non-verbose hint still promises fix suggestions that `--verbose` does not print. Measured through the built binary (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js doctor`, temp cwd with one `packages/spec/src/a.zod.ts` and no test): the non-verbose run ends with the hint; the `--verbose` run adds detail only to the ok environment rows and nothing to the warning. Not changed here (the dispatch scopes this PR to the verbose arm); reported to the seat.

## Verification

All readings are against HEAD `081a5101`.

After building the CLI they were re-run: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 29 passed (29).
